title: Former OpenAI science lead launches Warp Science to automate wet labs with robots
slides: Why would OpenAI's science lead walk away now?
Kai Wang spent years pushing AI into discovery
His new company, Warp Science, bets robots run experiments
Your wet lab costs may drop before competitors notice
Ask your lab lead what a robot could test this week
thread_text:
1. Why would OpenAI's science lead walk away now?

Kai Wang spent years pushing AI into discovery. He just left to bet on robots running experiments.

2. Warp Science bets on robot labs

His new company doesn't sell software. It sells robotic arms that run wet lab experiments end to end.

3. Your wet lab costs could drop

While competitors still hire postdocs to pipette, automated runs cut reagent waste and overnight cycles.

4. Robot experiments run while you sleep

Warp's pitch: machines test hypotheses 24/7, so iteration speed stops depending on human hours.

5. What could a robot test for you?

Ask your lab lead which single experiment this week could run without a human hand. That's your starting point.
